label: Codex-gpt-5.6-sol-reviewer2-fulltext-2026-10-03

country.paper_says: The study concerns a water system in Jambon Village, Kulon Progo Regency, Yogyakarta, Indonesia.

study_design.paper_says: “This research was conducted through field surveys, questionnaires and interviews” and examines a single SPAMDes case.

population.paper_says: Questionnaires were administered to SPAMDes managers and community members who were SPAMDes consumers.

sample_size.paper_says: “The management questionnaire was given to all managers with a total of three respondents” and “The total respondents were 21 consumers.”

urban_rural.paper_says: The system is repeatedly described as a “Community-based Rural Water System” located in Jambon Village.

service_provider.paper_says: The provider studied is SPAMDes Tirto Sari Ponces, managed by the Tirto Sari Ponces community group in Jambon Village.

regulatory_model.paper_says: Government Regulation No. 122/2015 establishes government responsibility for access to drinking water, but the paper says local people “initiatively developed their own water supply system,” managed by a community group; it does not state that this SPAMDes institution implements that regulation.

effect_measure.paper_says: The study scores four sustainability factors—“environmental, financial, technical, and managerial”—using questionnaires, interviews, and field surveys; an institutional dimension was discussed from prior literature but was not among the four dimensions assessed.
effect_measure.where: p. 4, Data Collection and Sustainability Scoring Method

effect_estimate.paper_says: The paper reports data from 3 managers and 21 consumers and describes SOPs, reporting, meetings, and four sustainability dimensions. It does not estimate institutional management practices as a determinant of continued service delivery under Regulation No. 122/2015.
effect_estimate.where: p. 3, Data Collection; pp. 7–8, Tables 5–7 and Operational and Management System; p. 11, Conclusion

extraction_note.paper_says: The supplied paper is identified as record RC4C6E385D8B9.

parsed.overall_comment: Most descriptive study fields are supported. The blank sample size omits the reported 3 managers and 21 consumers, while the regulatory and effect fields overstate links or dimensions not established by the paper.
